_comment: SAMPLE DATA — shown only until YOUTUBE_CHANNEL_ID (and optionally YOUTUBE_API_KEY) are set. Once they are, content/data/generated/youtube.json replaces this automatically.

videos.title: Your latest upload will appear here
videos.description: Set YOUTUBE_CHANNEL_ID in your repository secrets and this grid fills itself from the channel feed on every build.

videos.title: …along with the five before it
videos.description: Thumbnails, titles, durations and view counts all come straight from YouTube — nothing to update by hand.

videos.title: Refreshed on a schedule
videos.description: A GitHub Action re-fetches the channel every six hours so the site never drifts far behind the channel.
